archetypes.name: White-Blue Spirits
archetypes.plan: Build around Drogskol Captain: Build an evasive Spirit force, use flashback and tap effects to control races, and attack through the air.

archetypes.name: Blue-Black Zombies
archetypes.plan: Build around Diregraf Captain: Fill the graveyard and recur Zombies so removal trades become temporary setbacks rather than lost resources.

archetypes.name: Black-Red Vampires
archetypes.plan: Build around Stromkirk Captain: Pressure with Vampires, preserve attack triggers with removal, and snowball tribal bonuses across combat steps.

archetypes.name: Red-Green Werewolves
archetypes.plan: Build around Immerwolf: Develop Werewolves, pass selectively to transform them, and use instant-speed plays to keep the larger faces active.

archetypes.name: Green-White Humans
archetypes.plan: Build around Travel Preparations: Curve Humans into tribal or enter-the-battlefield bonuses, go wide, and attack with a strengthened team.
